items.title: Antigravity Cheminformatics Skills — AI agent for drug-design analysis
items.snippet: Cheminformatics Skills are a set of agent skills for Google Antigravity that let an agent collect compound data from literature and patents, curate it, and analyze it. The model plans the work and reasons about results, while deterministic chemistry tools built on RDKit do the actual calculations. DeepMind states that the full path from proposal to design took about an hour, significantly reducing the previous multiple-day timeframe. This advancement aids in early drug-design analysis by integrating AI agents with chemistry tools.

items.title: FlashProve — Anthropic's open-source proof of which model wrote a reply
items.snippet: FlashProve is an open-source tool released by Anthropic, offering a zero-knowledge proof that verifies which model generated a particular reply. This proof can be checked on a normal CPU, enhancing transparency and trust in AI model outputs. It represents a significant step towards provable inference for large language models.

items.title: Agentic engineering intelligence with Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.snippet: This article demonstrates building a multi-agent engineering assistant using Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to automate aerospace component substitution evaluation. The solution combines multimodal retrieval, deterministic evaluation, and agentic orchestration to replace manual cross-referencing of engineering specifications with automated evidence assembly for aerospace component substitution decisions. It utilizes multi-agent orchestration to route queries to specialist agents.

items.title: OpenAI says its AI is getting better at doing things humans do, like shopping and meal planning
items.snippet: OpenAI announced a new internal tool for assessing how AI handles everyday tasks, alongside research on its models' performance. The GPT-6 Astra model scored 93.1% at finding the right kindergarten after moving, 98% at managing community volunteers for a flood, and 90.4% at creating a meal plan for a parent with diabetes. This indicates significant progress in AI agents performing complex, real-world tasks.

items.title: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
items.snippet: CWE-bench v2 updates the evaluation benchmark for code generation models, emphasizing increased coverage, quality, and transparency. Among 11 models evaluated, Gemini 4 Argon achieved 67.8% pass@1 and 81.0% pass@4, slightly surpassing Claude Opus 5.5. The benchmark covers 91 different Common Weakness Enumerations (CWEs), indicating a wide range of vulnerability classes.

items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.snippet: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra model is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock, positioned as the everyday-workload line of the GPT-6 family. In OpenAI's Agents' Last Exam evaluation, Terra scored 15 percentage points higher than GPT-5.6 Terra and performed on par with GPT-6 Astra, completing tasks more than three times faster. The pricing for input and output tokens is at least 50% lower than GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-5.6 Terra.

items.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
items.snippet: Google DeepMind has released details on Genie 4, a new iteration of its world model, which is being rolled out as a research preview to trusted testers. Genie 4 significantly improves the simulation of people, creating characters that move naturally and respond organically to their environments, and can be interactively steered in real-time. It is also the first real-time world model to natively generate audio and introduces interactive dialogue that adapts on the fly.

items.title: Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
items.snippet: Deep Principle announced Hydrogen-1.0, a 753B GLM-5.3 post-train model with an MIT license, designed for scientific discovery. The model reports a 38.3% score on FrontierScience-Research, outperforming GPT-6-Astra's 33.3%. Its training incorporates lab records and discovery trajectories, targeting NVIDIA B200/B300 and AMD Instinct MI350X/MI355X GPUs for deployment.

items.title: litert-community/Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder
items.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder is CCORE's early-preview fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, specialized for generating interactive 3D scenes in Three.js. From a scene description, it writes a self-contained HTML file. The technical report outlines full fine-tuning of language parameters with a frozen vision encoder and a short LoRA stage on a dataset of 3,933 training scenes.

items.title: AWS sets up an on-behalf-of token exchange in Bedrock AgentCore Gateway so an agent calls ServiceNow as the signed-in user
items.snippet: AWS introduced a pattern for setting up an on-behalf-of token exchange in Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, allowing an AI agent to call ServiceNow as the signed-in user. This ensures that the user's identity, audit trail, and permissions remain intact when agents interact with enterprise APIs. The agent authenticates to the gateway with a JWT, which is then exchanged through the OBO flow for a token scoped to the ServiceNow connector, preserving user identity.
